description: Installation of a new metal gate, between two buildings in the North Eastern corner of the site. Gate purpose is to reduce unwarranted thoroughfare through the health centre site. Often used by school children to cut through to reach the local school, not suitable for a live health centre environment, particularly as this thoroughfare involves crossing the site car park. Gate is proposed to be finished to match adjacent site gates / fences, in a traditional black iron or iron finish.
site_name: St Charles Hospital, St Charles Centre For Health And Wellbeing
